page.overview:
What is Deist?

Deist is a recurring location in the Final Fantasy series. In both its appearances it is depicted as a hometown of dragoons and wyverns. A dragoon by the name of Ricard is a prominent character in both appearances of Deist. In both its appearances, Deist is also a target of an Imperial attack usually crowned with the decimation of the dragoons living there.

Deist is an island which acts as a location for the Deist Castle and the Deist Cavern.

Deist used to be the hometown of the Dragoons in Final Fantasy Dimensions, including Barbara, a guest party member. It is occupied by the Avalon Empire.
